jpmorgan-2025.every_line: The summary's heading ('Summary', the heading of Item 1A's risk factor summary, as Salesforce's 'Risk Factor Summary'), then the detailed section's category labels and one heading per risk factor, each set in bold and standing alone. Each line read is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list.
jpmorgan-2025.published_line_not_a_heading: The published value's last line, 'Parts I and II', is not read here: it is the running header JPMorgan prints at the top of the page where Part I ends (after the page number of the last risk-factor page, before the 'Item 1B.' heading), as it prints 'Part I' at the top of each right-hand page of Item 1A. It is page furniture, not a heading.

salesforce-2022.every_line: The Risk Factor Summary's heading and its category labels, then the detailed section's categories and one heading per risk factor; the category labels the summary names again over the detailed section are listed once, at their first occurrence, which is the shape the route publishes. Each distinct line is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list, the judgement made for the FY2026 report.
